import re

def parse_nginx_access_log(line: str) -> dict:
    """
    Parse a single nginx access log line into a dictionary.
    
    Expected format (combined log format):
    IP - - [timestamp] "METHOD /path HTTP/1.1" status bytes "referer" "user-agent"
    
    Example:
    192.168.1.1 - - [10/Oct/2023:13:55:36 +0000] "GET /index.html HTTP/1.1" 200 2326 "-" "Mozilla/5.0"
    """
    # Regex pattern for combined log format
    pattern = r'''
        ^(?P<ip>\S+)\s+
        (?P<ident>\S+)\s+
        (?P<user>\S+)\s+
        \[(?P<time>[^\]]+)\]\s+
        "(?P<request>[^"]*)"\s+
        (?P<status>\d{3})\s+
        (?P<bytes>\S+)\s+
        "(?P<referer>[^"]*)"\s+
        "(?P<user_agent>[^"]*)"
        \s*$
    '''
    
    match = re.match(pattern, line, re.VERBOSE)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f"Failed to parse log line: {line}")
    
    # Extract the request method, path, and protocol from the request field
    request_parts = match.group('request').split()
    if len(request_parts) >= 3:
        method = request_parts[0]
        path = request_parts[1]
        protocol = request_parts[2]
    else:
        method = path = protocol
